mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate of 0.12% compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is at or below 0.12% (measured by walk-forward out-of-sample returns).

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL value above 235 signals persistent inflation, prompting central bank tightening that compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL is above 235.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising unemployment (UNRATE > 5.5%) and declining housing starts (HOUST < 1000) signals a deteriorating economic outlook, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5 and HOUST < 1000.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion (defined by GDP growth above 16200 billion and consumer spending above 440000 million), the S&P 500 underperforms due to overvaluation, producing negative returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when GDPC1 > 16200 and RSAFS > 440000.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 105) signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 105.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE > 5.5%) signals a deteriorating labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5.

mechanism_narrative: Strong consumer spending (RSAFS > 440000 million) is associated with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days, as it reflects robust economic activity and corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when RSAFS is above 440000 million.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market (PAYEMS > 140000) signals robust economic growth and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS is above 140000.
